layout.body:
★★★★★
Wow Sound Earbuds are the best headphones for studying!
I researched a bunch of options, and these have the best price-to-quality ratio. Adequate sound, comfortable enough for long library sessions, easy-to-use Bluetooth connectivity, and an 8-hour battery! If you’re ok giving up some premium features, these are great for students on a shoestring.

questions.stem: According to the reviewer, what is one of the benefits of the WaveSound Earbuds compared to other products?
questions.analysis: According to the reviewer, what is one of the benefits of the WaveSound Earbuds compared to other products? 原文依据： I researched a bunch of options, and these have the best price-to-quality ratio. 翻译： 我研究了很多选择，这些耳机的性价比最高。 选项分析： (A) They are more reliable. 它们更可靠 → 错误（原文未提及可靠性相关内容） (B) They offer better value. 它们性价比更高 → 正确（“best price-to-quality ratio” 即性价比最高，对应 “better value”） (C) They are more luxurious. 它们更奢华 → 错误（原文提到 “giving up some premium features”，说明不具备奢华特性） (D) They sound better. 它们音质更好 → 错误（原文仅说 “Adequate sound”，即音质足够，未说比其他产品更好）

questions.stem: What aspect of student life does being “on a shoestring” refer to?

options.C: Studying for long periods of time

questions.analysis: What aspect of student life does being “on a shoestring” refer to? 原文依据： If you’re ok giving up some premium features, these are great for students on a shoestring. 翻译： 如果你不介意放弃一些高端功能，这些耳机非常适合预算紧张的学生。 选项分析： (A) Balancing work and academics 平衡工作和学业 → 错误（与 “on a shoestring” 所指的内容无关） (B) Having little spending money 几乎没有零花钱 / 预算紧张 → 正确（结合前文 “best price-to-quality ratio”，可推断 “on a shoestring” 指学生预算有限、花钱拮据） (C) Studying for long periods of time 长时间学习 → 错误（原文提到 “comfortable enough for long library sessions”，但这与 “on a shoestring” 无关） (D) Preparing for a future career 为未来职业做准备 → 错误（原文未提及职业准备相关内容）
